card.unknownProvider: This destination uses the provider "{{providerId}}", which this version does not recognise. Update the application or delete the destination.

addDialog.title: Add platform
addDialog.description: Configure a destination branch. You can add several destinations for the same platform.
addDialog.displayNameHint: Only used inside this application to tell your destinations apart.
addDialog.noCredentialsNote: No stream key is requested here. Add it from this destination's settings after creating it, once you know its display name.

settings.title: Platform settings
settings.providerImmutable: The platform cannot be changed. Delete this destination and add a new one instead.
settings.sortOrderHint: Lower values appear first on the dashboard.
settings.enabledDescription: Include this destination once streaming is implemented.
settings.hint: Changes are saved to the local database.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this destination?
deleteDialog.message: "{{platform}}" and its saved metadata and tags will be permanently removed from the database. This cannot be undone.

validation.displayNameTooLong: The display name cannot exceed {{max}} characters.
validation.sortOrderInvalid: Enter a sort order between 0 and 10000.
validation.streamKeyTooLong: The stream key exceeds the maximum allowed size.
validation.streamKeyInvalid: The stream key contains characters that are not allowed.
validation.serverUrlRequired: Enter a server address, or leave it empty.
validation.serverUrlTooLong: The server address exceeds the maximum allowed size.
validation.serverUrlInvalid: Enter a valid rtmp:// or rtmps:// address, with no username, password, fragment or query string.

output.explanation: The RTMP or RTMPS address your platform gives you for publishing - not the stream key, and not a secret. Ask your platform's stream settings page for it.
output.serverKeyDistinction: This is separate from the stream key above: both are needed before this destination can start sending.
output.autoRestartDescription: Restart this destination's process automatically after an unexpected failure, following a bounded backoff.

credentials.explanation: Stored in your operating system's credential store (Windows Credential Manager, macOS Keychain, or Linux Secret Service). Streaming Tree never displays it again after you save it.
credentials.notVerifiedNote: A stored key has not been checked against the platform - only that something was saved.
credentials.localIngestDistinction: This is not the same as the local ingest path ("live") OBS connects to below. That path is a route name, not a secret, and is unrelated to this key.
credentials.replaceNote: Saving a new key replaces the previous one.
credentials.deleteNote: Deleting the key prevents outgoing streaming to this destination until a new one is added.
credentials.storeUnavailableNote: Secure credential storage is not available on this system right now. The rest of the application is unaffected, but a stream key cannot be saved until it becomes available.
credentials.inputPlaceholder: Paste the stream key from your platform's dashboard

deleteDialog.title: Delete this stream key?
deleteDialog.message: The stored stream key for "{{platform}}" will be permanently removed from the operating system credential store. Outgoing streaming to this destination will not be possible until a new key is added. This cannot be undone.
